certification.name: HarvardX CS50's Introduction to Cybersecurity
certification.description: Single introductory Harvard course for technical and non-technical audiences covering passwords and authentication, phishing, malware, network attacks, encryption and privacy. Course-based verified certificate assessed through assignments, with no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Verified certificate price $449 shown on the edX page; the course can be audited for free without a certificate.
